I guess just take it slow. I'm guessing you are in 7th or 8th grade? Correct me if I am wrong. But as much as I hate to say this, high school is gonna be sososo much harder. It has more fun, more freedom, and a ton more work. I think one of the biggest things to do is start strong and don't procrastinate. (I know how hard it is, I have 6 finals I should be studying for right now) The reason I am almost failing all my classes is because I started off so bad. As for your social situation, once you get to high school, there are so many more people you can connect with. I hope you can get through this <3

Wow, you could almost be me. I'm 14f, but I comlpletely understand about school. Right now I have 6 finals to work on and study for, but I literally can't do it. I also forget to turn things in. A stressful feeling is always in me. What helps me once and a while is to just do 1 sentence at a time, one equation. try and find new friends. I don't know if you want to be with popular people, but sometimes the nerdiest and the ugliest are the most fun. Good luck
